meaning_and_requirement: Declare empty template, synthetic software fixture or an actual registered dataset; synthetic records cannot be presented as biological results.
One qualified common material/load-assay definition; analyze incompatible assays separately.
Common depth/leakage/indentation snapshot state; terminal crack paths and later fatigue follow-up are separate endpoints.
Same baseline exposure for material snapshots; cannot pool different times by giving them the same label.
Predeclared observation horizon H for first material failure; an estimand time point, not a clinical acceptance margin.
Requires independently measured minimum repair depth over the predeclared region; not maximum depth or an isolated favorable image.
Assay-specific nonnegative scale; no cross-assay conversion, clinical cutoff or zero imputation.
Unique pseudonymous registry key; register failures/missing follow-up before outcomes. Workbook cell positions are not specimen IDs.
Known physical donor identity; null means unknown, never a new independent donor per row.
Multiple coupons from one tooth remain nested; a known tooth cannot map to two different donors.
Retain batch even when confounded with donor or condition; no causal batch correction is estimated here.

grain: one declared repair region per specimen
meaning_and_requirement: The target and all linked measurements must refer to this same registered region; repeated regions are not additional independent specimens.
Prospectively defined experimental comparison label; not inferred from favorable outcomes.
Keep interface evidence separate by surviving substrate; do not inherit native-enamel results at a restoration edge.
Actual candidate/reference architecture; growth and prefabricated insert are distinct labels.
Individually defined intended repair depth. This script treats it as a supplied point target; uncertainty in the target needs a separately qualified extension.

grain: one snapshot packet per assigned specimen
meaning_and_requirement: Must join the registry exactly; duplicate packets, unknown specimens or mismatched regions fail validation.
Must match the common dataset baseline state/time. Destructive endpoints cannot be assigned to a still-tested coupon without valid lineage/time evidence.
Every null depth, leakage, terminal crack-path or fatigue field needs an explicit reason, including unknown reason when appropriate; absent entire packets remain in the assigned denominator.
Observed regional depth statistic; retained even if target is missing. It is not an indentation count or a source configuration depth.
Measurement bounds must bracket the observed value. Results state interval position relative to supplied target, never full material acceptance.
Specify measurement bound, confidence-interval procedure or synthetic bounds; subtraction does not change its uncertainty interpretation.
Exact is a measured value; left uses interval[0,limit]; right uses[limit,unbounded]. No LOD/2 substitution.
Measured value or censoring limit under the common assay. A null record contributes unknown[0,unbounded] only to all-assigned bounds, not an observed zero.

unit_or_type: none_detected or interfacial or mixed or cohesive_host or cohesive_repair
meaning_and_requirement: Describe observed crack route; none detected depends on assay resolution. Cohesive host/repair damage is not a successful interface or complete repair.
Actual time of crack-path adjudication; distributions at varying terminal times are not crack incidence at H or pre-fatigue predictors.
Only first material failure is an event; technical fixture loss is a censoring reason and must not become an event or successful runout.
Exact event uses equal bounds. Failure known by H when upper<=H; no failure by H when lower>H; a straddling interval remains unknown.

unit_or_type: interfacial or mixed or cohesive_host or cohesive_repair
meaning_and_requirement: Keep adverse material failure modes separately; a causal mechanism is not established by the label alone.
A censored specimen is known without failure by H only if observed event-free through H; censoring before H stays unknown without independent-censoring assumptions.
Unique measurement key; additional indents do not increase tooth/donor count.
Must join the same physical registry region and qualified baseline snapshot as other baseline material observations.
Study implementation supports this Hasan-anchored property only; not bulk KIc, host-repair junction toughness or a universal material score.
Average within specimen first, then within tooth and donor for the declared balanced estimand; report endpoint missingness and unknown identities.
Reports specimen-weighted and equal-tooth-then-equal-donor means with observed/assigned counts; no p-values, confidence intervals or causal effect.

grain: all assigned specimens in condition/substrate/architecture/target stratum
meaning_and_requirement: Lower=failure_known/N; upper=(failure_known+unknown)/N. These are finite-cohort identification bounds, not confidence limits or acceptance thresholds.
Average lower/upper observation bounds; null upper means no finite bound. This is not the mean of complete cases or an imputed-data estimate.
Material analysis cannot pass PDL, gums, pulp, original pose, full-crown load transfer or stability after finite support withdrawal.
